title: Atlas Launcher 1.7.1
summary: Atlas Launcher 1.7.1 fixes an update failure after the download.

sections.title: Launcher update
items: Fixed a Windows check that prevented the launcher from recognizing its update helper.
Download signature and integrity checks remain active.

sections.title: Installing this fix
items: From version 1.6.0 or 1.7.0, close Atlas Launcher and run the 1.7.1 installer downloaded from the release page.
Choose the usual installation folder. No prior uninstall is required.
